name: Kamellia
label: At market value
overview: Kamellia by Bellatrix Development is a premium residential tower located in the distinguished Jumeirah Peninsula within Maritime City, Dubai. This planned 51-storey development is designed to enhance the skyline of Dubai’s evolving waterfront district, offering contemporary apartments that cater to families, professionals, and investors seeking long-term value. As part of the masterplan of Maritime City, Kamellia provides a carefully structured addition to the residential landscape, combining modern architecture, high-quality finishes, and thoughtfully planned layouts. With its strategic design, the tower promises a lifestyle that balances urban convenience, scenic waterfront views, and a well-connected community. The first project milestone, known as the “first trace,” is scheduled for March 2026, signaling the commencement of the development phase. Kamellia represents a remarkable investment opportunity in a growing coastal district while offering residents a luxurious and serene urban living environment.
